title_as_printed: TABLE 1-EXPERIMENTAL WATER CONTENT IN CO2-RICH PHASE

footnotes_as_printed.*: 10^5 x mol fraction/2.11 = lbm/MMcf at 1 atm and 60 F.

pressure_note: Table gives 'Pressure' in psia and MPa with no further wording; the text refers to pressures from 100 to 2,000 psia; whether total cell pressure is not stated (it is the pressure of the CO2-rich fluid in equilibrium with water or hydrate; total pressure of the CO2/water system is used in the enhancement definition, Eq. A-10)

row_regime_overrides.reason: equilibrium phases column shows H2O(H), hydrate present (rows with CO2(l)/H2O(H) are also liquid-CO2 rich; hydrate recorded)
CO2(l)/H2O(l): CO2-rich phase is liquid, three-phase line or liquid CO2 with liquid water

row_from_literature.source: Ref. 4 (Kobayashi et al., final revised report to Arco Oil and Gas Co., 1979), marked ** in table

extra_unmapped: Equilibrium Phases column (phase identity, used for regime)
conversion_needs: psia to MPa not needed (MPa printed); F redundant with C
the water mole fraction column is f_L x 10^3 (mole fraction of water in the CO2-rich phase, per Nomenclature)
notes: Pressure and the 'Pressure' cell is printed once per isobar block; filled down to every row (carried forward). Temperature and pressure printed once for the two-row blocks with a second CO2(l)/H2O(l) phase (760, 840, 970, 1040 psia): T filled down. Row 2 (CO2(g)/ice, -8.0 C) has no liquid water or hydrate: below 273 K, regime empty, note below_273K. Hydrate rows are mostly below 273 K as well, and row 9-10 (0.0 and 2.5 C) in hydrate region. Row 41 is the three-phase critical end point (CO2(l)=CO2(g)); gas set to co2, regime empty. The 3-phase critical endpoint label printed as '3-phi critical endpoint' in the Equilibrium Phases column. Header footnote * (lbm/MMcf conversion) not a letter; recorded here, not in note column. Water content is of the CO2-rich phase (gas or liquid). Ref. 4 rows are from the same group's earlier report, not new measurements of this paper.
